name: MobileHeader
description: Mobile-optimised header with a back button, centred title, and an optional trailing action area. Designed for mobile navigation patterns where screen-level context and a return path are essential.

notes: The back button includes an accessible label via backLabel prop or defaults to 'Back'.
The title is rendered as a heading element for screen reader navigation.
Action button must receive an aria-label from the consumer when using an icon-only pattern.

title.description: Title text displayed in the centre of the header.

onBack.description: Callback fired when the back button is pressed.

backLabel.description: Accessible label for the back button.

actionIcon.description: Icon rendered in the trailing action button.

onAction.description: Callback fired when the action button is pressed.

className.description: Additional CSS class names to apply to the root element.

do: Use MobileHeader at the top of mobile views that need a back action.
Provide a meaningful backLabel when the default 'Back' is insufficient.
Provide aria-label on the root element when multiple headers exist on a page.
dont: Do not use MobileHeader on desktop layouts.
Do not use MobileHeader as a replacement for AppNavBar.
Do not render actionIcon without an onAction handler.
